hero.title: Your party, *your way*
hero.lede: A 1,300-square-foot room for up to 80 seated guests, with a caterer’s kitchenette, a custom beverage bar and an outdoor deck. Tables and chairs are included, and you can bring your own food and caterer.

sections.title: Twenty years of fun, *a new chapter*

image.alt: The South on Whiskey building under a big shade tree, with its red door

body: For 20 years this was the area’s family entertainment center, with an 18-hole miniature golf course and the largest batting cages in the CSRA.

The property and the building have since been extensively improved into an event venue with a “sophisticated Southern” feel. The mission hasn’t changed: a positive place to make lasting memories, with stellar service.
list: Open seven days a week, 7 am to midnight

items.text: Perfect space for my daughter’s gender reveal and baby shower! The owner was so nice and helpful through the entire process. It was like working with a family friend.
We had 70-80 guests and activities around the room and still had room for dancing!
items.by: Marilyn J., after a wedding celebration

items.text: They include the tables and chairs in the rental amount. John is so easy to work with and will help with any questions.
items.by: Connie S., after a bridal shower

items.a: Up to 80 seated inside. With the deck and the lawn as well, the venue suits gatherings of 20 to 125.

items.q: Can I bring my own food and drinks?
items.a: Yes. Bring your own food and drinks, or hire any caterer and vendors you like.
There’s a caterer’s kitchenette for staging and final prep, with a refrigerator, freezer and three-section sink. It isn’t a full cooking kitchen.
Cancellation and rescheduling depend on how much notice you give. Call to talk through your options, including moving your deposit to a new date.

sections.title: Come see the space
sections.text: Tours by appointment, seven days a week.
